question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing fullback, Bob is playing right back, and Claire is playing left back.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Alice and Claire trade positions. Then, Claire and Alice trade positions. Finally, Bob and Alice trade positions. At the end of the match, Claire is playing
Options:
(A) fullback
(B) right back
(C) left back
solution:
Positions in order (Alice, Bob, Claire):
Initial: (fullback, right back, left back)
1. Swap Alice and Claire: (left back, right back, fullback)
2. Swap Claire and Alice: (fullback, right back, left back)
3. Swap Bob and Alice: (right back, fullback, left back)
Claire is playing left back, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
